simple.summary: פָּצַל (pâtsal) means to peel First listed occurrence: Gen 30 37.

definitions.full: H6478. patsal [ מָּצַל ] verb Pi`el peel (Late Hebrew Pi`el split, divide ; so Arabic , Jewish-Aramaic (Talmud) מְּצַל , Syriac ; akin to בצל q. v.); — Perfect 3masculine singular מִּצֵּל Gen 30:38 (object rods); Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיְפַצֵּל 30:37 (c.accusative of congnate meaning with verb).
